description: A complex oscillator: four detuned sawtooths crossfaded against a sine an octave or two below them, the mix then driven into saturation

params.text: Sets the pitch, 0 giving C4 at 261.63Hz and one step an octave, over ten octaves; the tooltip shows the bare number with no frequency and no unit
Shifts the four sawtooths by up to a twentieth of an octave either way, leaving the sine where it is
Offsets that sawtooth by up to a tenth of an octave either way from the pitch the others follow
Sets the drive into the saturation stage, from unity gain up to five times
Crossfades the output from the four sawtooths alone through to the sine alone
Sets what the sine runs at against the sawtooths: half their frequency in one position and a quarter of it in the other, and it comes up at half

inputs.text: Adds to the pitch of all five oscillators at one volt per octave
Adds to the drive, 10V covering the whole of the Ψ knob, and the total is held between unity and five times
Adds to the crossfade, 10V covering the whole of the δ knob, and the total is held between the sawtooths alone and the sine alone

notes: the detune setting for the first sawtooth has no knob on the panel, so that oscillator always runs on the pitch and fine tune alone and the other three are detuned against it
monophonic: only the first channel of a cable into V/O is read

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V, so the knob alone; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
